DF_PARTICLE_EFFECTS.TypeHint: Visual fire or ice clipped to this region. It does not deal damage or change tokens.

enabled.label: Enabled
enabled.hint: Turn this effect on or off without deleting the behavior. The region's own Disabled checkbox also hides it. While this window is open, the map previews your changes. Close it without saving and the preview goes away.

effectType.label: Effect Type
effectType.hint: None keeps the settings but draws nothing. Fire and Ice show only the fields they use.

fireStyle.label: Fire Style
fireStyle.hint: Area Fire is irregular burning ground across the whole region and uses Arrangement, Density, Ember Amount and Edge Fade. Ball Of Fire is one radial fireball centered on the region; it uses Flame Scale (size), Flame Speed and Opacity.

arrangement.label: Arrangement
arrangement.hint: Single flame stacks sprites into one fire at the region center. Field draws one continuous top-down fire surface across the region (legacy sprite Field remains available in module settings).

density.label: Density
density.hint: For Field (shader): how much of the region burns versus floor gaps. For Field (legacy): how many flame sites per grid cells. 0 hides Field fire. Single flame ignores density.

flameScale.label: Flame Scale
flameScale.hint: For Field (shader): size of flame structures in the noise field. For Single / legacy Field: size of each flame sprite relative to the scene grid.

flameSpeed.label: Flame Speed
flameSpeed.hint: How fast the fire surface, flicker, and rising embers move.

opacity.label: Opacity
opacity.hint: Overall opacity of the effect. Keep this below 1 so the map stays visible.

emberAmount.label: Ember Amount
emberAmount.hint: Sparse rising sparks over the fire. For Field (shader) this scales with region size; for legacy Field it scales with flame sites. 0 disables sparks.

edgeFade.label: Edge Fade
edgeFade.hint: 0 keeps a hard edge. Higher values fade legacy flame bases and ember origins near the boundary. The region mask always clips the fire, including holes.

freezeMode.label: Freeze Mode
freezeMode.hint: Freeze once: the surface freezes over when the behavior is created or enabled, then stays frozen (after a reload it is already frozen). Already frozen: no animation. Loop: freeze, hold, start over.

freezeDuration.label: Freeze Duration
freezeDuration.hint: Seconds from clear ground to a fully frozen surface.

holdTime.label: Hold Time
holdTime.hint: Loop only: seconds the surface stays fully frozen before it starts over.

loopReset.label: Loop Reset
loopReset.hint: Loop only: how the ice clears before it freezes again. Thaw retreats toward the region edges; Fade dissolves the whole surface.

edgeBias.label: Edge Bias
edgeBias.hint: How strongly the ice grows in from the region edge (and from holes). 0 freezes in patches across the whole region.

crystalSize.label: Crystal Size
crystalSize.hint: Size of ice plates, cracks and frost veins relative to the scene grid.

refraction.label: Refraction
refraction.hint: How much the scene background is distorted and blurred under the ice. Only the background image is refracted, not tiles or drawings. Without a background image the ice is a translucent tint.

randomSeed.label: Random Seed
randomSeed.hint: Leave empty or 0 to keep a stable layout derived from this scene, region, and behavior. Any other number reshuffles only this fire.

quality.name: Fire quality
quality.hint: Caps legacy flames and embers per region and per scene. Shader surfaces are not affected. The saved region settings do not change.

fieldRenderer.name: Field fire renderer
fieldRenderer.hint: Shader draws one continuous top-down fire surface (recommended). Legacy keeps the old multi-campfire sprite Field for comparison. Arrangement Single is unchanged.
